Pinned source sets a Motion spring after in-view plus optional delay/startWhen, formats decimal precision and separator, and calls timed start/end callbacks. The live restart showed an intermediate 25 and later target 100; the 1.8s sample was still 97, not a settled endpoint. SSR exposes the final value, optional from supplies first visible entrance, updates reverse from current numeric value and duration is bounded rather than approximated by spring/timed callbacks. Native lifecycle cancels under offscreen/hidden/reduced/quiet states.
